name_zh: 格罗滕迪克谱序列定理
canonical_claim: For left-exact additive functors F : C -> D and G : D -> E between suitable abelian categories, if F sends injective objects to G-acyclic objects, there is a natural first-quadrant cohomological spectral sequence E_2^{p,q} = R^p G (R^q F(X)) converging to R^{p+q}(G composed with F)(X).
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; expected classical choice through injective resolutions
